name: 3D Gaussian Splatting
description: 3DGS agent for photorealistic volumetric synthesis: decomposes objects into anisotropic Gaussian ellipsoids with SH3 directional spherical harmonics and dynamic exposure.
capabilities: Anisotropic ellipsoid synthesis in 3D space with quaternions
Volume density self-critique with iterative refinement
Taxonomic archiving in the hierarchical 3D database
